oracle.name: Vision Quest
oracle.oracle_text: Search your library and/or graveyard for an artifact creature card with mana value X or less and put it onto the battlefield with X additional +1/+1 counters on it. If X is 4 or greater, it gains haste until end of turn. If you search your library this way, shuffle.

primary.scope: Vision Quest complete release-note section: X in library/graveyard costs is zero for mana value.

primary.inference: Choose a nonempty subset for and/or. Qualified hidden library may fail to find; a chosen public graveyard search must find if an eligible card exists. Chosen library alone may fail even if graveyard contains an eligible card.

discrepancy: Java two optional prompts allow neither zone and graveyard target0 even when eligible. Rust will use three nonempty zone subsets and public mandatory-find eligibility, per explicit CR inference.

obligations.clause: Sorcery XUR, actual colored payment and X selected/captured as a real cost quantity; no fake alternate X.
Search library, graveyard or both; three nonempty zone subsets, own cards only, one artifact AND creature with MV<=X, X in found-card cost is zero.
Qualified hidden library may fail to find; chosen public graveyard with an eligible card must find. Library is shuffled iff searched, even when nothing is found.
Put one exact selected current incarnation onto battlefield with X additional +1/+1 entry counters through pre-entry replacement and choice pauses.
If X>=4 the exact successfully entered permanent gains haste until end of turn, with ordinary layer6 timestamp/removal, independent from actual replaced counter amount.
Copied spells retain X and independent search state; captured semantic caster owns search/resources even when another player controls decisions.
Private library selection, legal/invalid choices, transaction atomicity, owned raw/index branches after parent disposal, restore and stale revision; actual/projected entry results agree.

shared_core.quantity: One item.x captured at resolution drives maximum mana value, additional counter quantity and threshold; spell copies retain packet X.
shared_core.search_state: Cold owned ZoneSearch records captured player/source/filter/X/zone subset and exact selected ObjectRef; selections remain in their zones until explicit FinishSearch. Current type/owner/zone/MV and exact incarnation are revalidated.
shared_core.entry: Reuse EntryMove.effect_counter and central pre-entry counter replacements. New private EntryMove.keywords_after grants timestamped EOT keyword effect only on actual successful battlefield result, after entry facts freeze and before subsequent triggers can resolve. Borrowed entry projection applies the same post-entry grant.
shared_core.cleanup: Zone-search continuation is removed on commitment or ordinary abandoned resolution; owned byte accounting includes initialized context.

development_history: Three compile-only iterations corrected explicit module imports, private funding test registration and its fixture constant; no query override or widened production API was introduced.
First executable matrix2/20passed. Authored Vision Quest lacked explicit x_symbols1 and fixed printedUR metadata; corrected both while gated, with paired metadata pin and metadata-only regeneration.

Next17/20 passed; corrected fixture assumptions about Synthoids1/3 body and its separate ETBsurveil2 trigger. Grave-only no-shuffle is asserted before that trigger; copied-search walker resolves it explicitly.
Next19/20 passed; combat fixture had checked damage before the damage step. Advanced through actual EndCombat;20/20 gated confirmation passed.
Promoted the whole card and removed its gated fallback. Final20new+55affected ordinary supported groups pass.
fixture_qualifications: Scene setup can seed mana, cards, phase and bounded moves; these are individual rules scenarios, not legal natural full games.

All final Vision Quest casts use the ordinary support-checked fixture path. The sole retained gated Marketback Walker fixture inspects immutable type/MV0 eligibility and never enters, resolves or admits that card.
No supported zero-mana-value artifact creature exists in this source parent. X0 ordinary payment/failure-to-find and gated immutable X0 eligibility are distinguished.

Entry replacement coverage includes actual DoublingSeason/Doc counter order, Authority tapped entry and private AdaptiveAutomaton entry choice. Explicit skipped/nonbattlefield EntryMove cases are bounded executor completion probes, not a claim of an unavailable printed battlefield-exile replacement.
Paid Choreographed Sparks copies the actual Vision Quest spell, retaining X and independent one-card searches; no hand-made copied packet substitutes for this case.
Funding assertion compares complete actual/projected ObjectView for counters/haste without mutating the parent; no pure performance claim.
